newsitem.title: USA: ERD Waste moves to Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
newsitem.headline: ERD Waste moves to Nasdaq SmallCap Market.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said on Friday that the listing of its common shares moved to the Nasdaq SmallCap Market from the Nasdaq National Market, effective May 9.
The company said the change reflects the impact of ERD's discontinuing operations at its Long Beach, N.Y., facility, as previously reported.
ERD said it was advised that the SmallCap listing more accurately reflects its current capitalization.
ERD is a waste management company. Its shares were down 1/16 to 1-15/16 in mid-afternoon trading.
